about: Every MDN page the docs cite, opened and read against the sentence that cites it (developer docs brief, CP4). Re-check a link, and update its date, whenever its sentence changes. A new MDN link needs an entry here first: src/lib/docs/mdn-links.test.ts.

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs.supports: sign-in: a JSON POST is preflighted with OPTIONS; the endpoint must allow the origin and headers; with credentials, Access-Control-Allow-Credentials and a named origin, never *.
shared-devices, browser-storage: ends when the tab is closed; survives reloads and restores; a page with an opener starts with a copy of the opener's sessionStorage.
shared-devices: the source of suggested values is up to the browser, typically past values the user entered.
browser-storage: data is deleted when the user deletes it in the browser's settings, and, under storage pressure, the least recently used origin's data is evicted.
